title: Ezekiel 38
paragraphs: ¹ The word of the LORD came to me: ² "Son of man, turn your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him. ³ Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. ⁴ I will turn you around and put hooks in your jaws, and I will bring you out with your whole army — horses and horsemen, all fully armed, a great company with shields and bucklers, all wielding swords — ⁵ with Persia, Cush, and Put among them, all with shields and helmets.

⁶ Also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops — and many other peoples with you. ⁷ Get ready; be prepared, you and all the companies gathered around you, and take command of them. ⁸ After many days you will be summoned. In later years you will come against a land recovered from war, a people gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. These people have been brought out from the nations, and now all of them are living safely. ⁹ You will advance, coming on like a storm — you and all your troops and many other peoples with you, like a cloud covering the land. ¹⁰ This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, thoughts will come to your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

¹¹ You will say, "I will march against a land of unwalled villages; I will attack those who are at peace and living in safety — people with no walls, no bars, no gates — ¹² to plunder and loot, to turn your hand against the resettled ruins and against the people gathered from the nations, who now have cattle and goods and live at the center of the land." ¹³ Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you: "Have you come to plunder? Have you assembled your forces to loot, to make off with silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to seize a great spoil?" ¹⁴ Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day when my people Israel are living safely, will you not take notice? ¹⁵ You will come from your place in the far north, you and many peoples with you — all of them riding horses, a vast army, a mighty force.

¹⁶ You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. In the last days this will happen, and I will bring you against my land so that the nations may know me, when I demonstrate my holiness through you before their eyes, O Gog. ¹⁷ This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one I spoke of in earlier times through my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied for years that I would bring you against them? ¹⁸ On that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, my fierce anger will flare up. ¹⁹ In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel. ²⁰ The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble, and every wall will fall to the ground.

²¹ I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Lord GOD. Every man's sword will be turned against his brother. ²² I will punish him with plague and with bloodshed. I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones, and burning sulfur on him and his troops and on the many nations with him. ²³ In this way I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
